# MetLL

> MetLL is an anonymous confession and AI-powered matchmaking app for Android. Users confess their secret crush anonymously — from school, college, the office, or any location. When mutual feelings are detected, MetLL instantly reveals the match so both people can connect and date.

MetLL is free to use. Available now on Google Play. iOS coming soon.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://metll.in/): Landing page with full product overview, features, and waitlist signup.
- [About](https://metll.in/about): Story behind MetLL and the team.
- [Safety Standards](https://metll.in/safety-standards): How MetLL protects user privacy and ensures safe, anonymous confessions.
- [Contact](https://metll.in/contact): Get in touch with the MetLL team.
